question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of (?) will logically complete the series.

solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) For square element → The number of lines is decreasing subsequently.

2) For circle element → The number of circles is increasing subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df870e829617ff7eafb6a79551551c7a2f2070b3bc832a6d87616ed8b9f05a45.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
